title: Potions, Potions And More Potions
description: A vanilla friendly mod that adds a variety of new potions with unique effects.
body:
![Header](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Potions_Potions_And_More_Potions/MP_PotionsPotionsAndMorePotions_header.webp)

Vanilla potion effects are certainly interesting, but I always thought there were so many new things you could add in order to make them even better. That's why I've decided to put together a small, vanilla friendly mod that will simply expand on the amount of potions available in the game. Potions, Potions and more Potions does precisely that. I've added multiple new potions with unique effects and many more yet to come! 

![Potions](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Potions_Potions_And_More_Potions/MP_PotionsPotionsAndMorePotions_potions.webp)

### Positive Effects

**Acrobatics**

Decreases fall damage without affecting your fall speed. Will not prevent you from dying.



**Archery**

Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons like bows, tridents and crossbows.



### Neutral Effects

**Lifting Winds**

Boosts targets into the air upon receiving the effect. Does not work on other players. 



**Martyr**

Each time you hit a target, you will take damage instead. Your target will be healed. Amount of damage / healing will increase with the potion's level.


### Negative Effects

**Sinking**

Targets will be dragged to the bottom whenever they are swimming. The higher the level, the faster they sink.



**Weight**

More subtle than the slowness effect. Slows targets down by 10% per level.



**Lightning**

A thunderbolt strikes each of your targets as they are hit by the potion. Will charge creepers or turn villagers.

**Fire**

Flames will devour your enemies! Throw this potion to set ablaze all enemies within range. This will also light up the block it lands on. You can even drink the potion yourself - though that may not be the smartest idea.

![Recipes](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Potions_Potions_And_More_Potions/MP_PotionsPotionsAndMorePotions_recipes.webp)

All of these potions can be crafted from an awkward potion. The ingredient required for the crafting process will be listed below.

 

**Acrobatics**: Allium

**Archery**: Flint

**Lifting Winds:** Feather

**Martyr**: Gold Nugget

**Sinking**: Iron Ingot

**Weight**: Iron Nugget

**Lightning**: Copper Ingot

**Fire:**: Magma Block
